title: In play: laws, table state and discard piles
description: A new In play view for everything that lies on the table for everybody: laws (with what passed, who was elected, the round and the votes), lingering card effects, the speaker and custodians tokens, public objectives, strategy cards with their trade goods, tokens on the map, and the discard piles the rules keep face up (action cards, agendas, exploration). On a phone it is an entry of the Menu and opens a full-height sheet; on desktop it is a header button next to Versions that opens a wide side panel which can stay open while the game goes on. Draw piles show only how many cards are left. Mocked game on the real UI (the data is the public engine state the page already receives).

shots.caption: An In play button in the header actions next to Technologies, Objectives and Versions.

shots.caption: Searching for a card name keeps only the sections that match.

shots.heading: Expanded law text
shots.caption: Long card text is clamped to three lines; the More button (keyboard operable) shows all of it.

shots.heading: Phone: Menu entry

notes.title: Reproduce
notes.text: cd web && rm -rf node_modules/.vite && npm run screenshots -- FR

notes.title: Data
notes.text: No new engine fields: everything is read from the redacted state, the view and the facts (action_cards, agendas, exploration) the page already receives, plus the agenda texts of the catalog.

notes.title: Not shown
notes.text: Draw pile contents and order, hands, the secret objective discard. Purged relics: the engine does not record them.
